name: Anthony Krotz
occupation: Platte County sheriff (appointed Oct. 17, 2025; elected November 2026). Cowboy State Daily reported in October 2025 that he was Platte County emergency management coordinator and had served as a police officer in Nebraska and Wyoming.
prior_offices: Police officer in Nebraska and Wyoming; Platte County emergency management coordinator (Cowboy State Daily, Oct. 14, 2025); Platte County sheriff (appointed Oct. 17, 2025, as stated on the official sheriff page, and elected in 2026)
background: Anthony "Tony" Krotz is the Platte County sheriff. The official sheriff page states that he was appointed sheriff on October 17, 2025, becoming the 16th sheriff of Platte County, after David Russell's resignation. Cowboy State Daily reported on October 14, 2025, that the county Republican Party nominated him as one of three finalists and that he was then the county emergency management coordinator and had served as a police officer in Nebraska and Wyoming. He was elected in the November 2026 general election; the official summary lists him with 3,034 votes.
